summary: Critical outage in orders-service caused by memory_leak (INC-0025)
description: Service orders-service incident INC-0025. Symptoms: container OOMKilled. Error: MemoryError: unable to allocate 128MB array in worker.py:64. Root cause was memory_leak. Followed runbook RB-memory-leak-restart.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for orders-service and applied RB-memory-leak-restart.
